label: Personal
research: Personio / Factorial: the employee list is searchable with filters (department, employment type, status) and an org chart as another view; the employee profile opens on a header (photo, position, status) with the key facts (contract, working hours, holiday balance, absences) and tabs/sections for personal data, compensation, absences and documents, each edited in its own panel. Absences are a team calendar with a colour per type and an 'Add absence' panel (type as buttons, date range, half day). Payroll preparation is a monthly table with an export and warnings. Taken: Personen with Liste · Organigramm as segments, the person page on its state (Stats: Urlaub übrig, Krank, Stunden, Brutto) with Vertrag/Rolle facts and 'Bearbeiten' / 'Persönliche Daten' as sheets, absences entered on the person page, the type as segments, Lohn with the month in the toolbar.
